purpose: One Static Collective garden of independently owned organs. Make work resumable across chats, machines, private/public repositories, and discontinuities without relying on a README, chat memory, or a universal authority database.

foundations.text: GHoT units of work are offers, tasks, execution attempts, and attributable receipts. Capability and planning are not execution or authority.
The Collective is one garden, not a collection of products; select the relevant owning organ for a task. Do not preload every repository or create a new master canon.

Authenticated repository discovery includes private repos by default when access exists. Do not publish private content or names to a public index; a public-only inventory must declare its coverage boundary.

AGENTS.md is the operating protocol, owner-written intent and source links hold foundations, and CONTINUE.md is generated. README is optional historical/onboarding material, not current operational authority.
Proposed, merged, deployed, field-tested, and user-corrected are different states. Never manufacture a test result or erase an earlier cut.

Before substantive work in a new ChatGPT conversation, perform one bounded search of relevant prior conversation history, related project aliases, corrections and earlier failures; verify against current owner sources. Private repositories count. A missing history source remains UNKNOWN and must not block useful work.
foundations.source: User correction 2026-11-19; working contract in AGENTS.md

next: Run an authenticated, local garden-wide router sweep with credentials authorized to read private and public repositories; compare observed coverage with the known 110-repository aperture; then configure trusted local scheduling and blind fresh-chat re-entry. Prove that events remain HELD and that GitBook/public docs never ingest private state.
unknowns: The code-level router and fixture tests do not establish live authenticated polling across all 110 repos; the connected GitHub tool's read access cannot be transplanted into a scheduled runner.
No trusted unattended local scheduler or external webhook is installed yet.
ChatGPT Project/custom instructions must be installed by the user; a GitHub AGENTS.md is not automatically loaded in arbitrary fresh chats.
Historical ChatGPT search may be bounded by memory settings, conversation availability and project settings.
